item.title: First release — the cloneable repo and the site
item.description:
The first public cut. Six skills, ten practices, the `pr_flow` rules, and a site to read it all from.
### What ships in the repo
- `CLAUDE.md`, `DESIGN.md` — the two files Claude reads first. - `pr_flow/` — three rules: `create-prd`, `generate-tasks`, `process-task-list`. - `skills/` — six starter skills: writing-prds, writing-release-notes, writing-stakeholder-updates, synthesizing-user-research, prioritizing-features, your-brand. - `mcp.json.example` — config template for GitHub / Linear / Notion / PostHog MCPs.
